t: Cleaning old nuts & bolts. | BobIsTheOilGuy
s: August 15, 2012 - Put the bolts and nuts in the bottom half bottle and use CRC Brake Cleaner to spray them. Any excess will be captured in the bottom of the half bottle. Let soak a while and spray again if necessary. Use a shop rag to wipe off the hardware. Let dry completely before reassembly. You them pour any residue by unscrewing the top of the bottle and pouring it into a container for safe disposal.
